Name: Shardust's Outdoors Fences Recolors (Including Pastels Version)
Author: Shardust
Description:
[center][/center][left][/left][center][size=3]﻿﻿﻿This mod adds a retexture and several recolor options, plus a winter overlay, on the outdoors fences. Change the fences around the Farm, around the Map, or both!

[/size][size=3](Main Version)
Retexture: Hardwood (mimics 'repaired' outdoors fences)
Color names: Amethyst, Aquamarine, Ash, Blackberry, Coal, Cocoa, Cream, Diamond, Emerald, Goldenrod, Mahogany, Mocha, Oak, Olive, Ruby, Rust, Saffron, Sapphire, Spinel, Steel, Topaz, Umber, Walnut, Wine

(Pastels Version)
Retexture: Hardwood (mimics 'repaired' outdoors fences)
Color names: Hazel, Honey, Lilac, Melon, Mint, Peach, Salt, Sugar

You can use the retexture, the recolors, and the winter overlay on the farm fences, the world map fences, or both.
You can use the winter overlay on the original fences without the retexture or the recolors. 
You can use the recolors on the original fences without the retexture or the winter overlay.
You can use the retexture without the recolors or the winter overlay.

Check the image gallery for in-game screenshots and how it looks like with GMCM, also included in the mod folder(s).[/size]
